context: Two friends discuss a concert event
purpose: Teach: オール/まき/捧げ/未熟/ルイ/聴衆/準決勝/脱線

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 昨夜のコンサート、聴衆の熱量がすごかった。
lines.en: Last night's concert had such incredible energy from the crowd.
lines.style: Immediate, bright opening. Warm nostalgia lifting through the sentence. Speaks with the glow of someone still living in the memory. Natural pace, generous.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 準決勝に進んだ若手バンドの演奏、よかった?
lines.en: Did the semi-finalist band's set go well?
lines.style: Soft, genuinely curious lean-in. Not performing interest—actually asking. Slight lift at the end like she wants to hear more. Intimate.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うん。最後の曲、ファンに捧げると言って、しみじみ。
lines.en: Yes. The closing song—they dedicated it to their fans, and it was really touching.
lines.style: Voice softens noticeably on the dedication. Slight pause before "touching" like she's feeling it again. Tender, almost surprised by her own emotion. Trails gently.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: MCで脱線するボーカル、面白かったよね。
lines.en: The vocalist going off on tangents during the MC was so fun.
lines.style: Light, conspiratorial. A small laugh almost built into the words. Warm observation, not mocking—genuine delight in the messiness. Easy.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: まだ未熟、と謙遜してたけど、十分プロ。
lines.en: They kept saying they were still immature, but honestly—they're already real professionals.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured. Slight conviction on "real professionals" like she's seeing something true beneath the surface. Soft but sure. A gift she's giving them.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ボートのオールみたいに、メンバーの息がそろってた。
lines.en: Like rowers with their oars in perfect sync—every member locked in together.
lines.style: Slow, deliberate metaphor. Speaking like she's watching it unfold in real time. Warm admiration in the tone. Breath steady, almost meditative. Sees the beauty in the coordination.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 前座のフランス人ピアニスト、ルイさんも素敵だった。
lines.en: Even the opener—Louis, the French pianist—was wonderful.
lines.style: Bright, generous. Equal enthusiasm for the supporting act. Natural, no hierarchy in her tone. Speaks with the confidence of someone who knows quality when she hears it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: まきストーブの店、終演後、寄ろう。
lines.en: Let's stop by the wood-stove café after—the one with the fireplace.
lines.style: Gentle suggestion, not demand. Warm invitation. Closes the circle of the evening. Soft, easy, looking forward to more time together.
